content:
Let:
- \(g\) = people on ground floor
- \(f\) = people on first floor
- \(s\) = people on second floor

People above someone: \(f+s=35\)  
People below someone: \(g+f=45\)  
One third live on first floor: \(f=\frac13(g+f+s)\)

Let total \(T=g+f+s\). Then \(f=\frac{T}{3}\), so \(T=3f\).

Also:
\[
T=g+f+s=(45-f)+f+(35-f)=80-f
\]
Thus:
\[
3f=80-f \Rightarrow 4f=80 \Rightarrow f=20
\]
So:
\[
T=3(20)=60
\]

\boxed{60}
